useful: counter_days: showed the zero-omission era (directions per day falling from 24 to 14-23 after 2025-06-15), the absent days, and the IN/OUT imbalance that exposed the Sept 2024 step
zeros(counter=True): found every all-zone outage stretch, which weather() then separated from rainy days
network: separated the feed-wide 2025-07-01/02 drop (heavy rain) and the partial final download from faults at this camera
compare: the ratio to the Dobroyd Pde tube confirmed the step change at the end of Sept 2024
duplicates: showed the 2024-11-29 duplicates repeat only zeros, so no change is needed
hourly: showed the zone profiles changing across the Sept 2024 step
not_useful: zeros per direction: the camera zones carry 0-15 bikes a day, so multi-day zero stretches are normal and the list is mostly noise
absent_zeros: flagged only the tiny zones, and counter_days showed the omission more clearly
improve: zeros: add rain_mm for the day to each stretch, since most all-zone stretches here were storms
daily: name the count column consistently (it is 'count' in daily but 'bikes' in counter_days)
meta: SITE_SK is a string in meta()['sites'] but an integer elsewhere
compare: allow comparing a whole counter (all its sites) against another site, not only one site
add: a step detector: per counter, the ratio of daily totals to a stable reference site and the IN/OUT balance, with the change points marked
a tool listing, per counter, the days on which each direction is absent while the counter publishes, split by pre- and post-zero-omission era

summary: G0493 is one Secure Agility camera (counter 322) at Gipps St / Broughton St, Concord, split into 12 low-volume zones. From 2025-06-15 the feed omits zero direction-days, and from November 2025 some zero slots, so this needs zero_fill; five all-zone zero stretches (commissioning, the start and end of the 2025-10/11 outage, the 2026-08 restart, and the partial last day) are set missing, while the other all-zone zero stretches fall on heavy-rain days and stand. The camera's totals and IN/OUT balance step at 2024-09-27, apparently a reconfiguration, so each zone's series is split there and the later period is flagged uncertain.
